result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial road with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a dedicated green-painted bike lane. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the multi-lane configuration and long crossing distance without a median refuge create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple travel lanes and a bike lane in a single stage without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the travel lanes may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, sidewalks, and green-painted bike lanes. While traffic signals are present, dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible, and parked vehicles near the corner may obstruct sight lines.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street near the intersection may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
